summary: Targeted worker-2/4/6 re-review completed from local paper material; final status is accepted_with_cautions with no open rework targets.

caution_findings.evidence_context: The paper reports an insect larval feeding assay, not antimicrobial MIC/MBC, hemolysis, or cytotoxicity assays.
DRAMP links the same LA-a/LA-b proteins through multiple source tables; duplicate database provenance is retained rather than collapsed in the audit.
The linked dbAMP rows have protein-name/activity context but no local sequence or assay-value fields, so they remain database_only_no_primary_source.
Local supplementary bins are article/figure-original HTML/link surfaces and the OA package contains figure images; no structured supplementary data table was recoverable locally.
The authors propose chitin hydrolysis as a possible defense mechanism but also caution that insecticidal activity may not be caused simply by chitinase activity.
